sources.excerpt: Death Metal by DigiTech | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE DigiTech Death Metal LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS DISTORTION Description Featuring a dual output, rugged chassis and EQ controls for low, mid, and high frequencies, the Digitech Death Metal is designed to bring high-gain buzz saw distortion at the stomp of a box. Dark, brutal, and vicious, this effect finds a natural place in death or thrash metal but also holds applications in noise rock or experimental.
